title: Griptape AI Orchestration Platform for VFX
summary: A framework and visual orchestration platform for building complex AI pipelines in professional visual effects. It enables node-based workflows for advanced models like Netflix's VOID for video inpainting and Meta's SAM3.1 for high-speed segmentation.
research_notes: Integrates VOID for automated clean plate generation and SAM3.1 for real-time multi-object tracking (Object Multiplex architecture).

evolution.summary: Acquired by Foundry in February 2026. The project evolved from a general-purpose Python AI agent framework into the core infrastructure layer for Foundry's AI-first VFX strategy and Nuke integration.
